常规胞 Γ，来自非零原胞波矢: Conventional-cell Γ, folded from a nonzero primitive-cell wavevector
三个原胞平移的相位全是 +1。同一个基元位点在每个原胞中的位移都相同，这一行确实: All three primitive translations have phase +1. Each basis site has the same displacement in every primitive cell, so this row is primitive-cell Γ.
这个整数波矢沿常规胞的三条基矢平移时相位都为 +1，因此折叠到常规胞 Γ。原胞还: This integer wavevector has phase +1 under every conventional-cell basis translation, so it folds to conventional-cell Γ. The primitive cell also permits the F-centering translations within the conventional cell. The phase row contains −1, so at least one primitive translation reverses the displacement even if the currently selected translation preserves it. This row belongs to the primitive-cell X star.
Si 的立方常规胞含八个原子，分成四份两原子基元。下面使用原始 Si 结构的分数: The cubic conventional cell of Si has eight atoms, arranged in four copies of a two-atom basis. The exercise uses fractional coordinates from the original Si structure. Pick a common displacement axis, mark the arrow direction with + or −, and compare the four copies of the basis.
选择一个相位行: Choose a row of translation phases
k 使用常规胞倒易分数坐标。相位行的四列依次对应 0、t₁、t₂、t₃。四个 k: The wavevector k uses conventional-cell reciprocal coordinates. The four entries in each phase row correspond to 0, t₁, t₂, and t₃. All four wavevectors have conventional-cell periodicity.
沿哪条原胞基矢平移？: Which primitive basis vector should the translation follow?
同一个基元位点在平移前后的坐标与位移符号: Coordinates and displacement signs for the same basis site before and after translation
A 和 B 是原胞中两个 Si 基元位点。坐标超出常规胞时按周期折回。: A and B are the two Si basis sites in a primitive cell. Coordinates outside the conventional cell wrap back periodically.
所选相位行也属于原胞 Γ 吗？: Does the selected phase row also belong to primitive-cell Γ?
核对 24 个位移自由度: Account for all 24 displacement degrees of freedom
四个格心位置上的相位行两两正交。每行可分别乘上两原子各三个方向的位移，所以常规胞: The phase rows on the four centering positions are pairwise orthogonal. Each row can multiply independent displacements along three directions for each of the two atoms, so the 24 coordinates at conventional-cell Γ split into four six-dimensional sectors. The all-in-phase sector is primitive-cell Γ. The other three correspond to the three arms of one X star. The six dimensions follow from translation symmetry and the displacement degrees of freedom. Computing frequencies requires the dynamical matrix.
先选一行，再用下面的链接打开结构转换。完成原文件核验后检查输入波矢，用现有按钮手: Choose a row and follow the link to the structure tool. Verify the original file and check the input wavevector, then run the conversion and open the representation workbench. Compare the little-group order and number of star arms for Γ and any X row.
用官方 Si 文件核对所选波矢 →: Check the selected wavevector with the official Si file →
查看四行的波矢换基与结果: See the basis changes and results for all four rows
来自相位行的波矢采用 Si 常规胞的倒易分数坐标。载入并手动转换后，再用 BC: The chosen phase row uses reciprocal fractional coordinates of the Si conventional cell. Verify and load the file, run the conversion, then use the BC primitive coordinates to compare the star arms and little-group order.
再试一次。原胞 Γ 必须在三条原胞基矢的平移下都保持同号。试着换一条基矢，或者检: Try again. At primitive-cell Γ, the displacement sign must stay the same under all three primitive basis translations. Try another basis vector or check the phase row.
